words.enDefinition: program text written in a programming language, as used by a programmer or translated by tools

examples.en: We opened the source code to see how the program read temperatures.
examples.zh: 我们打开「源代码」，想看程序怎样读取温度数据。

examples.en: The instructor distributed the source code along with the worksheet for Friday.
examples.zh: 老师连同周五的练习表一起发了「源代码」。

words.enDefinition: A file storing programming language instructions before their execution or translation

examples.en: I saved the source file before running the exercise in the terminal.
examples.zh: 我先保存「源文件」，再在终端里运行练习程序。

examples.en: The sample source file contained instructions for printing a weekly timetable.
examples.zh: 「源文件」样本含有打印一周课表的指令。

words.enDefinition: A displayed or printed version of a program's written instructions

examples.en: The handout used a code listing to show the whole example program.
examples.zh: 讲义用一份「代码清单」展示了完整的示例程序。

examples.en: I marked the section of the code listing that printed the receipt.
examples.zh: 我在「代码清单」上标出了打印收据的那部分。

words.enDefinition: A short piece of code presented separately for an example

examples.en: The tutor pasted a code snippet into the console to demonstrate printing.
examples.zh: 导师把一段「代码片段」粘贴到控制台里演示打印。

examples.en: I added a code snippet to my notes instead of the entire program.
examples.zh: 我往笔记里加了一段「代码片段」，只摘了程序的一小部分。

words.enDefinition: An informal description of program logic using code-like language

examples.en: We wrote pseudocode before opening the editor for the price exercise.
examples.zh: 我们为价格练习写了「伪代码」，然后才打开编辑器。

examples.en: The worksheet used pseudocode to describe the steps without a specific language.
examples.zh: 练习表用「伪代码」描述步骤，写法不受某门语言限制。

words.enDefinition: An application designed for writing and editing programming language files

examples.en: I used a code editor to remove accidental formatting from the example.
examples.zh: 我用「代码编辑器」去掉了示例里误加的格式。

examples.en: The code editor opened both source files in tabs beside each other.
examples.zh: 「代码编辑器」把两个源文件放在相邻的标签页里打开。

collocations: open a file in a code editor

words.enDefinition: An application combining code editing, running, and often debugging tools

examples.en: Our lab used an integrated development environment to run Java from the editor.
examples.zh: 我们在实验课上用「集成开发环境」，直接从编辑器运行 Java 程序。

examples.en: The integrated development environment showed program output below the source file after each run.
examples.zh: 每次运行后，「集成开发环境」都把程序输出显示在源文件下方。

collocations: open a project in an integrated development environment

words.enDefinition: The in-memory copy of a file being edited before changes are saved

examples.en: My changes were in the editor buffer while the old script still ran.
examples.zh: 我的修改还在「编辑器缓冲区」里，运行的仍是旧脚本。

examples.en: The editor restored the editor buffer when I reopened the lab project.
examples.zh: 我重新打开实验项目时，编辑器恢复了「编辑器缓冲区」。

words.enDefinition: Coloured formatting that makes different parts of code easier to distinguish

examples.en: The syntax highlighting made comments easier to find in the Java example.
examples.zh: 「语法高亮」让 Java 示例里的注释更好找。

examples.en: My syntax highlighting changed after I selected the language for the new file.
examples.zh: 我给新建文件选择语言后，「语法高亮」的显示变了。

words.enDefinition: The margin beside source lines showing numbers, markers, or other indicators

examples.en: I saw a red dot in the editor gutter beside the print line.
examples.zh: 我看到打印语句旁边的「编辑器侧栏」有一个红点。

examples.en: The editor gutter displayed line numbers in the IDE used for our lab.
examples.zh: 实验课用的集成开发环境在「编辑器侧栏」里显示行号。

collocations: a mark in the editor gutter
line numbers in the editor gutter

words.enDefinition: Temporarily hiding sections of code without deleting any source text

examples.en: We used code folding to hide completed sections during the live demonstration.
examples.zh: 我们在现场演示中用「代码折叠」收起了已经讲完的部分。

examples.en: The student enabled code folding to make the longer example easier to scan.
examples.zh: 学生开启「代码折叠」，方便快速浏览较长的示例。

words.enDefinition: A comment whose text ends at the current line's boundary

examples.en: I wrote a single-line comment above the instruction that printed the answer.
examples.zh: 我在打印答案的指令上方写了一条「单行注释」。

examples.en: The teacher used a single-line comment to explain why the example starts at zero.
examples.zh: 老师用一条「单行注释」解释示例从零开始的原因。

words.enDefinition: A comment enclosed by markers that can cover several lines

examples.en: The Java example started with a block comment describing the purpose of the exercise.
examples.zh: Java 示例开头有一段「块注释」，说明练习的目的。

examples.en: I closed the block comment before writing the next line of JavaScript.
examples.zh: 我先结束「块注释」，再写下一行 JavaScript。

words.enDefinition: Turn a source line into a comment to prevent its execution

examples.en: I decided to comment out a line while checking where the repeated message came from.
examples.zh: 为了查明重复消息来自哪里，我决定「把一行代码注释掉」。

examples.en: Could you comment out a line in the example before we run it again?
examples.zh: 再次运行示例前，你能「把其中一行代码注释掉」吗？

collocations: comment out a line while debugging
remember to comment out a line

words.enDefinition: Spaces or tabs before the first visible characters on a line

examples.en: The editor displayed leading whitespace so we could see the copied spaces.
examples.zh: 编辑器显示了「行首空白」，方便我们看清复制过来的空格。

examples.en: In the Python exercise, leading whitespace changed how the lines were grouped.
examples.zh: 在 Python 练习里，「行首空白」改变了代码行的分组方式。

words.enDefinition: A position in the hierarchy defined by how far lines are indented

examples.en: The last print line sat at a different indentation level from the others.
examples.zh: 最后一条打印语句和其他几条处在不同的「缩进层级」。

examples.en: I matched the indentation level of both lines before rerunning the Python exercise.
examples.zh: 我先统一两行的「缩进层级」，再重新运行 Python 练习。

words.enDefinition: Language syntax in which indentation has a structural or grammatical role

examples.en: Our tutor introduced indentation-sensitive syntax by moving one line in the Python example.
examples.zh: 导师通过移动 Python 示例中的一行来介绍「用缩进分组的语法」。

examples.en: The diagram showed how indentation-sensitive syntax could change the result without changing the words.
examples.zh: 这张图说明，即使用词没变，「用缩进分组的语法」也可能使程序结果发生变化。

words.enDefinition: Use space characters to move code inward from the left margin

examples.en: We set the editor to indent with spaces for the Python worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把编辑器设为「用空格缩进」，用来做 Python 练习。

examples.en: The style guide asked everyone to indent with spaces in the shared examples.
examples.zh: 风格指南要求大家在共用示例里「用空格缩进」。

collocations: configure an editor to indent with spaces

words.enDefinition: Tabs and spaces used together to indent the same code

examples.en: The editor marked mixed tabs and spaces after I pasted in the copied code.
examples.zh: 我粘贴复制的代码后，编辑器标出了「制表符和空格混用」的位置。

examples.en: We checked whether mixed tabs and spaces explained the indentation complaint in our Python exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了 Python 练习中的缩进报错是否由「制表符和空格混用」造成。

words.enDefinition: A line with no visible characters separating source text or output

examples.en: I added a blank line between the two sections of the example.
examples.zh: 我在示例的两个部分之间加了一条「空行」。

examples.en: The output showed a blank line before the final total on screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的输出在最终合计前有一条「空行」。

words.enDefinition: Extending one logical source line across more than one displayed line

examples.en: The guide explained line continuation by spreading a long Python calculation over two lines.
examples.zh: 指南把一个长 Python 算式写到两行上，说明什么是「续行」。

examples.en: I checked the line continuation rules before wrapping the expression inside the editor.
examples.zh: 我先查了「续行」规则，再在编辑器里替表达式换行。

words.enDefinition: A single source line as understood by a language's syntax rules

examples.en: The Python expression spanned two physical lines but formed one logical line under the grouping rules.
examples.zh: 这段 Python 表达式跨两条物理行，但按分组规则组成一条「逻辑行」。

examples.en: The example joined the parts of the calculation into one logical line.
examples.zh: 示例把算式的各个部分接成了一条「逻辑行」。

collocations: join text into a logical line
the end of a logical line
one logical line across physical lines

words.enDefinition: A source line separated from the next by an actual newline

examples.en: The comment ended at the end of the first physical line in Python.
examples.zh: 在 Python 中，该注释到第一条「物理行」末尾就结束了。

examples.en: I moved part of the expression onto another physical line in the file.
examples.zh: 我把表达式的一部分移到文件中的另一条「物理行」上。

collocations: continue onto the next physical line

words.enDefinition: The character encoding used to read the text of a source file

examples.en: The Python handout explained source encoding before showing names with accents.
examples.zh: Python 讲义先介绍了「源文件编码」，再举出带重音符号的名字。

examples.en: The editor reopened the file after I corrected its source encoding setting.
examples.zh: 我修正「源文件编码」设置后，编辑器重新打开了文件。

words.enDefinition: A small recognized unit of source text, such as an operator

examples.en: The parser treated the plus sign as a separate lexical token.
examples.zh: 语法分析器把加号视为一个独立的「词法单元」。

examples.en: Our exercise labelled each lexical token before arranging them into an expression.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中先标记各个「词法单元」，然后把它们组成表达式。

words.enDefinition: A program component that analyses input according to its grammatical structure

examples.en: The parser noticed that I had forgotten to close the parentheses.
examples.zh: 「语法分析器」发现我忘了补上右括号。

examples.en: Our tutor explained which part of the interpreter acted as a parser.
examples.zh: 导师解释了解释器的哪个部分充当「语法分析器」。

words.enDefinition: An editor action for executing the currently selected part of a program

examples.en: I chose run selection to try the arithmetic without starting the entire program.
examples.zh: 我选了「运行选中的代码」，单独试算这一小段。

examples.en: The lab instructions showed where to find run selection in the editor.
examples.zh: 实验说明指明了编辑器里「运行选中的代码」在哪里。

collocations: use Run Selection in an editor

words.enDefinition: Editor suggestions that fill in partly typed source code

examples.en: The first code completion suggestion showed how to finish the built-in function's name.
examples.zh: 第一条「代码补全」建议显示了这个内置函数的完整名称。

examples.en: I used code completion while entering the name of the print function.
examples.zh: 输入打印函数的名称时，我用了「代码补全」。

words.enDefinition: A searchable menu of actions available inside a software editor

examples.en: I opened the command palette to find the option for running Python.
examples.zh: 我打开「命令面板」，找到运行 Python 的选项。

examples.en: Our tutor searched the command palette for the action that changes interpreters.
examples.zh: 导师在「命令面板」里找了切换解释器的操作。

collocations: choose an action from the command palette

words.enDefinition: Software that executes program instructions from source or an intermediate representation

examples.en: The interpreter accepted my next line after printing the first result.
examples.zh: 「解释器」打印第一个结果后，接受了我输入的下一行。

examples.en: I checked which interpreter the editor was using for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我检查了编辑器为这次练习选用的是哪个「解释器」。

words.enDefinition: A tool that translates code into another executable or intermediate representation

examples.en: The compiler translated the Java source before the classroom program ran.
examples.zh: 课堂程序运行前，「编译器」先翻译了 Java 源代码。

examples.en: Our tutor showed where the compiler placed the generated files.
examples.zh: 导师展示了「编译器」把生成的文件放在哪里。

words.enDefinition: The stage when code is translated and checked before execution

examples.en: The lesson explained why Java complained at compile time about the assignment.
examples.zh: 课上解释了 Java 为什么在「编译阶段」就对这条赋值语句报错。

examples.en: We listed checks that took place at compile time in the example.
examples.zh: 我们列出了示例中在「编译阶段」执行的检查。

collocations: detect an error at compile time

words.enDefinition: While a program is actually being executed

examples.en: The program learned the filename at run time from what I typed.
examples.zh: 程序「在运行时」从我的输入中得知文件名。

examples.en: The diagram showed what happens at run time when the program reads input.
examples.zh: 这张图展示了程序「在运行时」读取输入会发生什么。

collocations: check a value at run time

words.enDefinition: A stage in preparing code that translates it into another form

examples.en: The compilation step produced class files before we ran the Java example.
examples.zh: 运行 Java 示例前，「编译步骤」生成了类文件。

examples.en: I repeated the compilation step after fixing the incorrect source line.
examples.zh: 我修好错误的源代码行后，重新执行了「编译步骤」。

words.enDefinition: A message reporting something the compiler discovered during code analysis

examples.en: The compiler diagnostic named a source file and showed a line number.
examples.zh: 「编译器诊断信息」列出一个源文件名，还显示了行号。

examples.en: Our tutor looked at the first compiler diagnostic before discussing later messages.
examples.zh: 导师查看第一条「编译器诊断信息」后，再讨论后面的提示。

words.enDefinition: a compiler diagnostic that ordinarily flags a potential problem without treating it as a compilation error

examples.en: The Java example produced a compiler warning after the tutor changed one declaration.
examples.zh: 导师改了一条声明后，Java 示例出现了一条「编译器警告」。

examples.en: I read the compiler warning even though the class file had appeared.
examples.zh: 虽然类文件已经生成，我还是看了那条「编译器警告」。

collocations: a compiler warning about an unchecked operation

words.enDefinition: The platform or representation for which a compiler produces code

examples.en: The lab used the same compilation target for everyone building the Java example.
examples.zh: 实验课上，所有人生成 Java 示例时都用相同的「编译目标」。

examples.en: We compared the compilation target with the runtime available in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们把「编译目标」和教室里可用的运行时环境作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A file created by translating source code during a build

examples.en: The fresh compiled artifact appeared after I recompiled the changed Java source.
examples.zh: 我重新编译修改过的 Java 源码后，出现了新的「编译产物」。

examples.en: We identified which compiled artifact came from the last successful compilation.
examples.zh: 我们确认了哪个「编译产物」来自上一次成功的编译。

collocations: the location of a compiled artifact

words.enDefinition: An intermediate instruction format executable by a language runtime or virtual machine

examples.en: The tutor showed bytecode between the Java source and its execution.
examples.zh: 导师展示了 Java 源代码从编写到执行之间的「字节码」。

examples.en: We compared bytecode from two versions of the same short program.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一个短程序两个版本的「字节码」。

words.enDefinition: Instructions encoded for direct execution by a particular processor architecture

examples.en: The diagram showed native machine code as the form a processor could execute directly.
examples.zh: 图上显示，「原生机器代码」是处理器可以直接执行的形式。

examples.en: Our tutor contrasted native machine code with intermediate instructions produced in the first step.
examples.zh: 导师把「原生机器代码」与第一步生成的中间指令作了对比。

collocations: translate bytecode to native machine code

words.enDefinition: Translation of program code into executable instructions during execution

examples.en: The diagram showed just-in-time compilation happening after the JavaScript engine had started running.
examples.zh: 图上显示，JS 引擎开始运行后才发生「即时编译」。

examples.en: Our tutor explained how just-in-time compilation could happen for frequently executed code.
examples.zh: 导师解释了经常执行的代码如何可能触发「即时编译」。

collocations: a language engine with just-in-time compilation

words.enDefinition: Translation of program code into its target form before execution begins

examples.en: The worksheet used ahead-of-time compilation to illustrate code translated before starting the program.
examples.zh: 练习表通过「提前编译」说明程序启动前代码已被翻译的情形。

examples.en: We noted where ahead-of-time compilation belonged on the example program's execution timeline.
examples.zh: 我们记下了「提前编译」在示例程序执行时间线上的位置。

collocations: compare ahead-of-time compilation with runtime compilation

words.enDefinition: The reference implementation of Python, written primarily in the C language

examples.en: The lab used CPython to demonstrate what a Python interpreter does.
examples.zh: 实验课用「Python 参考实现」来演示 Python 解释器的作用。

examples.en: Our notes listed CPython as one implementation of the Python language.
examples.zh: 笔记把「Python 参考实现」列为 Python 的一种实现。

words.enDefinition: saved bytecode that the runtime can reuse if it still matches the source under the relevant validity checks

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the bytecode cache after importing the Python example.
examples.zh: 导入 Python 示例后，导师指出了「字节码缓存」的位置。

examples.en: We compared the bytecode cache with the source files still used for editing.
examples.zh: 我们把「字节码缓存」和仍用于编辑的源文件作了比较。

collocations: a file in the bytecode cache

words.enDefinition: a file in the JVM class-file format describing a class or interface and containing method bytecode where applicable

examples.en: The newly created class file appeared beside the Java source in our exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，新生成的「Java 类文件」出现在 Java 源文件旁。

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the class file generated by the Java compiler.
examples.zh: 导师指出了 Java 编译器生成的「Java 类文件」。

collocations: run code from a class file
the location of a class file

words.enDefinition: the specified execution machine for the Java class-file format, implemented by runtimes that load and execute class files

examples.en: The Java Virtual Machine ran the compiled example after the source was translated.
examples.zh: 源代码翻译完后，「Java 虚拟机」运行了编译好的示例。

examples.en: We identified the Java Virtual Machine in a diagram between bytecode and hardware.
examples.zh: 我们在图中找到了字节码与硬件之间的「Java 虚拟机」。

collocations: run on the Java Virtual Machine
run bytecode in a Java Virtual Machine

words.enDefinition: A package of tools and runtime facilities for developing Java programs

examples.en: The lab instructions identified the Java Development Kit available on the shared machines.
examples.zh: 实验说明指出了共用机器上可用的「Java 开发工具包」。

examples.en: I checked which Java Development Kit our editor used to compile the example.
examples.zh: 我检查了编辑器用哪个「Java 开发工具包」来编译示例。

collocations: use the Java Development Kit compiler

words.enDefinition: The virtual machine and libraries needed to run compiled Java programs

examples.en: The diagram placed the virtual machine inside the Java Runtime Environment alongside supporting libraries.
examples.zh: 图上把虚拟机和配套库都放在「Java 运行环境」里。

examples.en: We compared the Java Runtime Environment with a package that also provided development tools.
examples.zh: 我们把「Java 运行环境」和还提供开发工具的一套软件作了比较。

collocations: run a program in a Java Runtime Environment
components of the Java Runtime Environment
a Java Runtime Environment for the program

words.enDefinition: The JDK command that compiles Java sources into class files

examples.en: We used javac before opening the folder containing the new class file.
examples.zh: 我们先用了「Java 编译命令」，然后打开存放新类文件的文件夹。

examples.en: The handout showed how javac produced files from the Java example.
examples.zh: 讲义展示了「Java 编译命令」怎样根据 Java 示例生成文件。

collocations: compile a source file with javac

words.enDefinition: The command-line tool that starts a Java program or source file

examples.en: The Java launcher started our example after its class file had been produced.
examples.zh: 类文件生成后，「Java 程序启动工具」运行了我们的示例。

examples.en: The guide listed the Java launcher separately from the command used for compilation.
examples.zh: 指南把「Java 程序启动工具」与用于编译的命令分开列出。

collocations: start a program with the Java launcher
run a source file with the Java launcher

words.enDefinition: A Java launch mode running source without a separate compilation command

examples.en: We ran the small example in Java source-file mode directly from its source file.
examples.zh: 我们用「Java 源文件运行模式」，直接从源文件运行了小示例。

examples.en: The instructions illustrated Java source-file mode with a short classroom program saved as source.
examples.zh: 说明用一个保存为源代码的课堂小程序演示了「Java 源文件运行模式」。

collocations: an example of Java source-file mode

words.enDefinition: A Java method called to start execution of an application

examples.en: The Java application displayed a message from its main method when started.
examples.zh: Java 应用启动时，在「Java 程序入口方法」中显示了一条消息。

examples.en: We marked the main method before following the program into another method.
examples.zh: 跟着程序走到另一个方法之前，我们先标出了「Java 程序入口方法」。

words.enDefinition: The location or function where a program begins running

examples.en: The example used its main method as the entry point for execution.
examples.zh: 示例用主方法作为执行的「程序入口」。

examples.en: I marked the entry point before describing what the program did next.
examples.zh: 我先标出「程序入口」，再描述程序接下来的操作。

words.enDefinition: Instructions written outside the bodies of defined functions or classes

examples.en: The top-level code in the example printed a banner when the file ran.
examples.zh: 运行文件时，示例中的「顶层代码」打印了一条横幅消息。

examples.en: We moved the second print instruction out of the top-level code.
examples.zh: 我们把第二条打印指令移出了「顶层代码」。

collocations: place a statement in top-level code

words.enDefinition: A Python condition restricting code to runs as the main program

examples.en: The main guard kept the example's input prompt tied to running the file directly.
examples.zh: 「主程序入口判断」让示例只在直接运行文件时提示输入。

examples.en: Our tutor added a main guard before reusing the calculation in another exercise.
examples.zh: 导师在另一个练习复用计算代码之前，加了「主程序入口判断」。

collocations: place code under the main guard

words.enDefinition: Software that reads and executes JavaScript code in a supported environment

examples.en: The JavaScript engine evaluated the expression I entered during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 「JS 引擎」求出了我在演示时输入的表达式的值。

examples.en: We read a diagram showing the JavaScript engine inside the browser.
examples.zh: 我们看了一张标出浏览器内「JS 引擎」的图。

collocations: run code in a JavaScript engine

words.enDefinition: An environment providing an engine and support for executing JavaScript

examples.en: The JavaScript runtime in our test provided access to a simple console.
examples.zh: 测试中的「JS 运行时」提供了一个简单控制台。

examples.en: Our tutor distinguished the JavaScript runtime from its engine in the diagram.
examples.zh: 导师用图说明了「JS 运行时」与其中引擎的区别。

collocations: run a script in a JavaScript runtime

words.enDefinition: A JavaScript mode enforcing stricter rules for some language behaviour

examples.en: The tutor enabled strict mode before comparing two versions of the JavaScript example.
examples.zh: 导师先启用「严格模式」，再比较 JavaScript 示例的两个版本。

examples.en: We checked which behaviour changed under strict mode in the classroom program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了课堂程序在「严格模式」下哪些行为有变化。

words.enDefinition: Translate edited source code again to generate updated executable material

examples.en: We had to recompile the source after changing the text that Java displayed.
examples.zh: 改变 Java 显示的文字后，我们得「重新编译源代码」。

examples.en: I remembered to recompile the source before trying the example with new input.
examples.zh: 给示例试用新的输入前，我记得「重新编译源代码」。

words.enDefinition: The release of an interpreter used to execute a program

examples.en: I noted the interpreter version after noticing the file ran differently in the lab.
examples.zh: 我注意到文件在实验课上运行方式不同，就记下了「解释器版本」。

examples.en: The guide asked us to check the interpreter version before opening the examples.
examples.zh: 指南要求我们在打开示例前先确认「解释器版本」。

words.enDefinition: Choose the installed language implementation that will execute a program

examples.en: I had to select an interpreter after opening the class project on a new machine.
examples.zh: 在新机器上打开课堂项目后，我得「选择解释器」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed how to select an interpreter for the small Python script.
examples.zh: 导师演示了怎样为这个 Python 小脚本「选择解释器」。

collocations: select an interpreter in the editor
select an interpreter for the project

words.enDefinition: A mode accepting and evaluating instructions while the user types

examples.en: I opened Python in interactive mode to try the short calculation.
examples.zh: 我以「交互模式」打开 Python，试算这个短算式。

examples.en: The tutor used interactive mode while demonstrating how each line was evaluated.
examples.zh: 导师用「交互模式」演示每一行如何求值。

collocations: try an expression in interactive mode

words.enDefinition: A way of running instructions from a saved program file

examples.en: Our exercise used script mode after we saved the code for reading input.
examples.zh: 保存了读取输入的代码后，我们在练习中用了「脚本模式」。

examples.en: I switched to script mode to run all the instructions together.
examples.zh: 为了把所有指令放在一起运行，我切换到「脚本模式」。

words.enDefinition: A marker showing an interactive session is ready for another command

examples.en: The interactive prompt appeared again after the interpreter displayed the answer.
examples.zh: 解释器显示答案后，「交互提示符」再次出现。

examples.en: I waited for the interactive prompt before typing my next Python instruction.
examples.zh: 我等「交互提示符」出现后，才输入下一条 Python 指令。

words.enDefinition: A prompt showing that an interactive instruction needs another line

examples.en: Python displayed a continuation prompt while waiting for the rest of the expression.
examples.zh: Python 等待表达式的剩余部分时，显示了「续行提示符」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to the continuation prompt after entering the unfinished first line.
examples.zh: 导师输入还没写完的第一行后，指向「续行提示符」。

collocations: enter text at the continuation prompt

words.enDefinition: An interactive cycle that reads, evaluates, and displays results from input

examples.en: The diagram showed how a read-eval-print loop handled each line I entered.
examples.zh: 图上展示了「读取求值打印循环」怎样处理我输入的每条指令。

examples.en: We tried a simple expression in the read-eval-print loop before opening a file.
examples.zh: 打开文件前，我们在「读取求值打印循环」里试了一个简单表达式。

collocations: run code in a read-eval-print loop
the stages of a read-eval-print loop

words.enDefinition: The JDK's tool for entering and evaluating Java code interactively

examples.en: The lab used JShell to show how Java handles simple arithmetic.
examples.zh: 实验课用「Java 交互式工具」演示 Java 怎样处理简单算术。

examples.en: I tried the calculation in JShell while my partner edited the file.
examples.zh: 同伴编辑文件时，我在「Java 交互式工具」里试算了那个算式。

words.enDefinition: A browser tool showing messages and accepting interactive JavaScript commands

examples.en: We used the browser console to evaluate an arithmetic expression in JavaScript.
examples.zh: 我们用「浏览器控制台」对一个 JavaScript 算术表达式求值。

examples.en: The tutor cleared the browser console before showing what the example printed.
examples.zh: 导师先清空「浏览器控制台」，再展示示例打印的内容。

collocations: view messages in the browser console
run an expression in the browser console

words.enDefinition: Messages or results displayed in a console by a running program

examples.en: I compared the console output from two runs of the same program.
examples.zh: 我比较了同一程序运行两次的「控制台输出」。

examples.en: The console output showed the prices before displaying the final total.
examples.zh: 「控制台输出」先显示了各项价格，之后才显示最终合计。

words.enDefinition: A piece of information passed to a program when starting it

examples.en: The file name was passed as a command-line argument when the example started.
examples.zh: 示例启动时，文件名作为「命令行参数」传给了程序。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one command-line argument and ran the same program again.
examples.zh: 导师改了一个「命令行参数」，然后再次运行同一个程序。

words.enDefinition: An ordered collection of command arguments available to a running program

examples.en: I inspected the argument vector to see whether the name contained a space.
examples.zh: 我查看了「命令行参数序列」，确认文件名中是否含空格。

examples.en: The sample program printed the argument vector as a list of separate values.
examples.zh: 示例程序把「命令行参数序列」打印成一项项分开的值。

collocations: an entry in the argument vector
read values from the argument vector

words.enDefinition: A named command-line option used to request particular program behaviour

examples.en: The handout showed a command-line flag that changed how much the example printed.
examples.zh: 讲义展示了一个能改变示例打印多少内容的「命令行选项标记」。

examples.en: I removed a command-line flag and compared the result with my first run.
examples.zh: 我去掉一个「命令行选项标记」，并和第一次运行的结果比较。

collocations: a command-line flag for extra output

words.enDefinition: Saved settings specifying how an editor starts a program

examples.en: The launch configuration named the script to open when I clicked Run.
examples.zh: 「运行启动配置」指定了我点运行时打开的脚本。

examples.en: We checked whether the launch configuration passed the filename to our program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了「运行启动配置」是否把文件名传给了程序。

collocations: a launch configuration for a program

words.enDefinition: The process that executes code in a computational notebook

examples.en: The notebook kernel kept my earlier results in memory between calculations.
examples.zh: 「交互笔记本执行内核」在两次计算之间把前一次的结果保留在内存里。

examples.en: Our tutor checked which notebook kernel the classroom exercise was using.
examples.zh: 导师确认了课堂练习在用哪个「交互笔记本执行内核」。

words.enDefinition: A section of a computational notebook containing executable instructions

examples.en: The first code cell displayed the temperature after I entered a value.
examples.zh: 输入数值后，第一个「代码单元格」显示了温度。

examples.en: I added a code cell below the explanation to show the calculation.
examples.zh: 我在说明下方加了一个「代码单元格」来展示计算过程。

words.enDefinition: The displayed result produced by running code in a notebook cell

examples.en: The cell output still displayed yesterday's result until I ran the cell again.
examples.zh: 在我再次运行单元格之前，「单元格输出」还显示着昨天的结果。

examples.en: I copied the cell output so I could compare the two runs.
examples.zh: 我复制了「单元格输出」，这样就能比较两次运行。

words.enDefinition: A notebook number showing a cell run's order in the current session

examples.en: The execution count showed that I had run the bottom cell first.
examples.zh: 「单元格执行计数」显示，我最先运行了底部单元格。

examples.en: We compared the execution count beside each cell in the sample notebook.
examples.zh: 我们比较了样本笔记本中各个单元格旁的「单元格执行计数」。

collocations: look at a cell's execution count
the execution count in a notebook

words.enDefinition: Stop and start a notebook's code execution process to reset state

examples.en: I had to restart the kernel before checking whether the notebook worked from scratch.
examples.zh: 在确认笔记本能否从头运行之前，我得先「重启笔记本内核」。

examples.en: We chose to restart the kernel after the calculation stopped responding during class.
examples.zh: 课上的计算停止响应后，我们选择「重启笔记本内核」。

collocations: restart the kernel before running again
restart the kernel from the menu

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for reading incoming text or other data

examples.en: The exercise read a number from standard input before printing the result.
examples.zh: 练习程序先从「标准输入」读取一个数字，再打印结果。

examples.en: I replaced typed standard input with a file for the same example.
examples.zh: 我对同一个示例改用文件内容作为「标准输入」，原先是手动输入。

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for sending its normal results or messages

examples.en: The sample script wrote the total to standard output after reading both numbers.
examples.zh: 示例脚本读完两个数字后，把合计值写入「标准输出」。

examples.en: We compared standard output with messages printed to the error stream.
examples.zh: 我们把「标准输出」与写入错误流的消息作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A program's default stream for reporting errors and diagnostic messages

examples.en: The script wrote its file warning to standard error in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，脚本把有关文件的警告写到了「标准错误输出」。

examples.en: Our tutor displayed standard error separately from the program's main results.
examples.zh: 导师把「标准错误输出」和程序的主要结果分开显示。

collocations: a message sent to standard error

words.enDefinition: A message asking a user to enter data for a program

examples.en: I changed the input prompt so it asked for the temperature in Celsius.
examples.zh: 我改了「输入提示」，让它要求用户输入摄氏温度。

examples.en: The input prompt appeared before the program waited for me to type.
examples.zh: 程序等我输入之前，出现了「输入提示」。

words.enDefinition: Display characters or data just received from the user again

examples.en: The sample chose to echo the input before calculating the total from it.
examples.zh: 示例选择先「回显输入」，再据此计算总数。

examples.en: I added a line to echo the input while checking what the program read.
examples.zh: 我添加一行来「回显输入」，检查程序读到了什么。

collocations: configure a program to echo the input
decide whether to echo the input

words.enDefinition: Temporary storage holding output data before it is sent onward

examples.en: The message stayed in the output buffer until the example sent it onward.
examples.zh: 示例把消息传出去前，消息留在「输出缓冲区」里。

examples.en: Our tutor used the output buffer diagram to explain the delayed display.
examples.zh: 导师用「输出缓冲区」示意图解释了为什么会延迟显示。

words.enDefinition: Send buffered output onward without waiting for accumulated data

examples.en: The sample had to flush output before waiting for the next entry.
examples.zh: 示例等待下一次输入前，得先「立即送出缓冲的输出」。

examples.en: Our tutor chose to flush output so the progress message appeared promptly.
examples.zh: 导师选择「立即送出缓冲的输出」，让进度消息及时显示。

words.enDefinition: output buffered until a line ending or another flush condition sends the accumulated data onward

examples.en: The line-buffered output sent each message onward after its closing newline.
examples.zh: 「按行缓冲的输出」在写入每条消息末尾的换行符后，把消息送出。

examples.en: The diagram used line-buffered output to show why partial lines were delayed.
examples.zh: 图上通过「按行缓冲的输出」说明为什么不完整的行会延迟显示。

words.enDefinition: Pause further work until incoming data is available to read

examples.en: The program seemed quiet because it had to wait for input from us.
examples.zh: 程序看上去没有动静，因为它得「等待我们输入」。

examples.en: After printing the question, the example would wait for input before calculating anything.
examples.zh: 示例打印问题后，会先「等待输入」，再开始计算。

collocations: wait for input from a user
wait for input at a prompt

words.enDefinition: A code returned to the calling environment when a program ends

examples.en: I checked the exit status when the program ended without printing a result.
examples.zh: 程序结束时没打印结果，我查看了「退出状态码」。

examples.en: The guide explained how the exit status differed between the example runs.
examples.zh: 指南说明了几次示例运行的「退出状态码」有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A returned code other than zero, often indicating unsuccessful execution

examples.en: The sample returned a nonzero exit status when its data file was missing.
examples.zh: 示例找不到数据文件时，返回了「非零退出状态码」。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a nonzero exit status appeared in the execution summary.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么执行摘要中出现「非零退出状态码」。

collocations: a run with a nonzero exit status

words.enDefinition: Finish program execution without being stopped by an exception or interruption

examples.en: The example could terminate normally after printing the final line of results.
examples.zh: 示例打印最后一行结果后就能「正常结束」。

examples.en: Our tutor watched the short program terminate normally after it completed the calculation.
examples.zh: 导师看着这个短程序做完计算后「正常结束」。

collocations: expect a program to terminate normally

words.enDefinition: An execution stopped before its planned work has been completed

examples.en: The interrupted run left only the first two totals visible on screen.
examples.zh: 「被中断的一次运行」只在屏幕上留下了前两个合计数。

examples.en: We treated the interrupted run as incomplete when comparing the exercise results.
examples.zh: 比较练习结果时，我们把「被中断的一次运行」视为未完成。

collocations: resume work after an interrupted run
a log from an interrupted run

words.enDefinition: The Python exception raised when it receives a user interrupt

examples.en: The demonstration showed KeyboardInterrupt after the user interrupted the running script.
examples.zh: 用户中断运行中的脚本后，演示显示了「键盘中断异常」。

examples.en: The terminal displayed KeyboardInterrupt when I pressed the interrupt shortcut during the classroom calculation.
examples.zh: 课堂计算仍在运行时，我按下中断快捷键，终端显示了「键盘中断异常」。

words.enDefinition: A problem caused by code violating a language's grammar

examples.en: The syntax error prevented the incomplete instruction from running in our example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「语法错误」导致没写完整的指令无法运行。

examples.en: The tutor fixed a syntax error and ran the example again before class.
examples.zh: 课前导师修正了一处「语法错误」，再次运行了示例。

collocations: a syntax error in the file

words.enDefinition: A mistake that gives incorrect behaviour even though the code runs

examples.en: A logic error made the program print the subtotal instead of the total.
examples.zh: 「逻辑错误」导致程序打印了小计，该打印的总计没显示。

examples.en: We looked for a logic error after the example finished with unexpected numbers.
examples.zh: 示例运行结束给出了意外的数值，我们于是查找「逻辑错误」。

collocations: detect a logic error in the calculation

words.enDefinition: A source element encountered where the language grammar does not allow it

examples.en: The JavaScript console reported an unexpected token beside a closing bracket.
examples.zh: JavaScript 控制台在一个右方括号旁报告了「意外的词法单元」。

examples.en: We located the unexpected token before checking the previous line for clues.
examples.zh: 我们先定位「意外的词法单元」，再去上一行找线索。

words.enDefinition: A pointed diagnostic symbol highlighting a position in displayed source text

examples.en: The caret indicator pointed near the place where parsing had stopped.
examples.zh: 「插入符位置标记」指在语法分析停止位置的附近。

examples.en: I used the caret indicator to begin looking for the missing bracket.
examples.zh: 我从「插入符位置标记」指的位置开始找漏掉的括号。

collocations: a caret indicator under a character

words.enDefinition: The class or category identifying which kind of problem occurred

examples.en: The exception type told us the program had failed to find a file.
examples.zh: 「异常类型」告诉我们，程序没找到某个文件。

examples.en: I copied the exception type from the last line of the diagnostic.
examples.zh: 我从诊断信息最后一行复制了「异常类型」。

collocations: the exception type in a traceback

words.enDefinition: Text associated with a specific exception giving details about what happened

examples.en: The exception message included the name of the file that was missing.
examples.zh: 「异常说明信息」包含了没找到的文件名。

examples.en: We read the exception message after checking where the program had stopped.
examples.zh: 我们先确认程序停在哪里，再读「异常说明信息」。

collocations: an exception message with a filename

words.enDefinition: An exception for which the running program has no active handler

examples.en: An unhandled exception stopped the exercise before it could print the answer.
examples.zh: 一个「未处理的异常」让练习程序在打印答案之前停了下来。

examples.en: The debugger paused after the unhandled exception while we inspected the details.
examples.zh: 出现「未处理的异常」后，调试器暂停，让我们查看详细信息。

collocations: a log containing an unhandled exception

words.enDefinition: A Python error report showing calls leading up to an exception

examples.en: The traceback pointed to my exercise file and a particular line.
examples.zh: 「Python 异常回溯」指明了我的练习文件和其中的一行。

examples.en: Our tutor read the traceback to see how the calls were connected.
examples.zh: 导师读了「Python 异常回溯」，了解各次调用之间的关系。

collocations: examine the last line of a traceback

words.enDefinition: a report of frames on a call stack at a particular point, such as when an exception arose

examples.en: The Java stack trace showed which helper method was running when the class exercise raised an exception.
examples.zh: Java 的「调用栈跟踪」显示，课堂练习抛出异常时正在运行哪个辅助方法。

examples.en: I looked through the stack trace to find the first line from my file.
examples.zh: 我查看「调用栈跟踪」，找第一条来自我文件的记录。

collocations: a stack trace for an exception

words.enDefinition: A call stack entry representing one active function or method call

examples.en: I selected a stack frame to see what values that call received.
examples.zh: 我选了一个「栈帧」，查看那次调用接收了哪些值。

examples.en: We checked which stack frame belonged to the helper in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核对了哪个「栈帧」对应练习中的辅助函数。

words.enDefinition: The source line whose execution directly resulted in an error

examples.en: The failing line tried to read a file we had not created yet.
examples.zh: 「触发错误的代码行」尝试读取一个我们还没有创建的文件。

examples.en: We read the name printed beside the failing line in the traceback.
examples.zh: 我们看了异常回溯中「触发错误的代码行」旁印出的名称。

collocations: step back from the failing line

words.enDefinition: A Python exception raised when a referenced name cannot be found

examples.en: A misspelled variable name caused a NameError in the short exercise.
examples.zh: 这个短练习中，变量名写错引起了「Python 名称错误」。

examples.en: The tutor showed which name appeared in the NameError message.
examples.zh: 导师指出「Python 名称错误」信息里出现了哪个名称。

collocations: a NameError for an undefined name

words.enDefinition: A JavaScript exception raised when a name cannot currently be referenced

examples.en: The console showed a ReferenceError for a name our example never defined.
examples.zh: 示例从未定义那个名称，所以控制台显示了「JS 引用错误」。

examples.en: We read the ReferenceError before checking spelling in the rest of the file.
examples.zh: 我们先看了「JS 引用错误」，再查文件其他部分的拼写。

words.enDefinition: A Python syntax exception indicating invalid indentation in source code

examples.en: The example produced an IndentationError because the next instruction was misaligned.
examples.zh: 下一条指令没对齐，导致示例出现「Python 缩进错误」。

examples.en: The traceback showed which line of source triggered the IndentationError.
examples.zh: 异常回溯显示了源代码的哪一行触发了「Python 缩进错误」。

collocations: fix the cause of an IndentationError

words.enDefinition: A Python exception caused by inconsistent indentation using tabs and spaces

examples.en: A TabError appeared after I pasted lines with inconsistent leading whitespace.
examples.zh: 粘贴了行首空白不一致的几行后，出现了「缩进混用异常」。

examples.en: The TabError led us to inspect how that block was indented.
examples.zh: 「缩进混用异常」让我们去检查那块代码是怎么缩进的。

words.enDefinition: A Python exception indicating a requested file or directory does not exist

examples.en: The script showed FileNotFoundError when I typed a nonexistent file name.
examples.zh: 我输入一个不存在的文件名时，脚本显示了「文件或目录缺失异常」。

examples.en: Our tutor read the filename reported with FileNotFoundError in the example.
examples.zh: 导师读了示例中随「文件或目录缺失异常」报告的文件名。

words.enDefinition: a Python exception raised by operations such as input when they encounter end-of-file without reading a value

examples.en: The exercise displayed EOFError when it expected another line but received nothing.
examples.zh: 练习程序需要再读一行却没收到内容，因此显示「输入提前结束异常」。

examples.en: We saw EOFError after the example tried to read from empty input.
examples.zh: 示例尝试从空的输入中读取时，我们看到了「输入提前结束异常」。

words.enDefinition: A tool for controlling execution and inspecting what a program does

examples.en: We started the debugger so we could watch the example execute slowly.
examples.zh: 我们启动「调试器」，这样就能慢慢观察示例运行。

examples.en: The debugger showed the program's values while the calculation was paused.
examples.zh: 计算暂停时，「调试器」显示了程序中的各个值。

collocations: run a program in the debugger

words.enDefinition: Mark a position where the debugger should pause program execution

examples.en: I needed to set a breakpoint on the line before the result was printed.
examples.zh: 我需要在打印结果前的那行「设置断点」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to set a breakpoint near the instruction that reads input.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在读取输入的指令附近「设置断点」。

collocations: set a breakpoint on a line
set a breakpoint before a call
set a breakpoint in the debugger

words.enDefinition: Run the current debugger line without tracing into its function calls

examples.en: I chose step over to run the call without entering its body.
examples.zh: 我选了「单步跳过」，让调用直接执行完，不进入函数内部。

examples.en: The tutor used step over because we were only checking the caller.
examples.zh: 导师选择「单步跳过」，因为我们只需要检查调用者。

words.enDefinition: Follow the current call into the called code using a debugger

examples.en: We chose step into to follow the program into the calculation helper.
examples.zh: 我们选了「单步进入调用」，跟着程序进入计算用的辅助函数。

examples.en: I used step into because I wanted to see the method's first instruction.
examples.zh: 我用了「单步进入调用」，想看到该方法的第一条指令。

words.enDefinition: A debugger expression whose current value is displayed during pauses

examples.en: I added a watch expression for the running total before resuming execution.
examples.zh: 继续运行前，我给累计合计值加了一个「监视表达式」。

examples.en: The watch expression changed after the program read the second number.
examples.zh: 程序读取第二个数字后，「监视表达式」的值发生了变化。

collocations: a watch expression in the debugger

words.enDefinition: A console for messages or interactive evaluation during a debugging session

examples.en: We checked the debug console while the program was stopped at a breakpoint.
examples.zh: 程序停在断点时，我们查看了「调试控制台」。

examples.en: I entered a calculation in the debug console to check the stored value.
examples.zh: 我在「调试控制台」输入一个算式，核对已存储的数值。

collocations: evaluate an expression in the debug console

words.enDefinition: A program's reference to a file that it has already opened

examples.en: The example used a file handle to read the file one line at a time.
examples.zh: 示例通过「文件句柄」逐行读取那个文件。

examples.en: We checked when the file handle stopped being usable in the program.
examples.zh: 我们核对了程序里「文件句柄」何时变得不可用。

words.enDefinition: A file mode treating content as characters through decoding or encoding

examples.en: The program opened the names file in text mode for the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，程序以「文本模式」打开姓名文件。

examples.en: Our tutor explained why text mode returned readable characters from the file.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么「文本模式」从文件读出的是可读字符。

collocations: open a file in text mode
read a file in text mode

words.enDefinition: A file opening mode allowing the program to read existing contents

examples.en: We opened the file in read mode to inspect the saved list.
examples.zh: 我们以「读取模式」打开文件，看看保存的列表。

examples.en: The example used read mode when it only needed to count lines.
examples.zh: 示例只需要统计行数，因此采用「读取模式」。

collocations: a file opened in read mode

words.enDefinition: in Python's open function, the mode that creates the file if needed and truncates existing contents when opened

examples.en: The sample opened a fresh file in write mode for its results.
examples.zh: 示例以「写入模式」打开了一个新文件来存放结果。

examples.en: Our Python exercise used write mode when the old result needed replacing.
examples.zh: 我们在 Python 练习里用「写入模式」替换原有结果。

collocations: a file opened in write mode

words.enDefinition: A file opening mode that writes new data after existing contents

examples.en: We used append mode to put a new temperature below the earlier readings.
examples.zh: 我们用「追加模式」把一条新温度记录写到已有读数下方。

examples.en: The example opened the log in append mode before adding one more line.
examples.zh: 示例以「追加模式」打开日志，再加一行。

collocations: write to a file in append mode

words.enDefinition: a rule for representing text as code units or bytes so that a system can store or exchange it

examples.en: The character encoding mattered because the names file contained accented letters.
examples.zh: 姓名文件中有带重音符号的字母，因此「字符编码」很重要。

examples.en: We checked the character encoding before opening the sample text in Python.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「字符编码」，再用 Python 打开示例文本。

collocations: read text using a character encoding

words.enDefinition: A failure when bytes cannot be interpreted using the selected encoding

examples.en: The script reported a decoding error when it read the older file.
examples.zh: 脚本读取较旧的文件时报告了「解码错误」。

examples.en: We checked the saved text format after seeing a decoding error in Python.
examples.zh: 在 Python 里看到「解码错误」后，我们检查了文本保存格式。

collocations: read text without a decoding error

words.enDefinition: A character or sequence marking the end of a text line

examples.en: The editor showed which line ending each line used in the text file.
examples.zh: 编辑器显示了文本文件中每一行使用的「行结束符」。

examples.en: Our tutor compared files using a different line ending in each case.
examples.zh: 导师比较了采用不同「行结束符」的文件。

words.enDefinition: A newline character at the end of some text or output

examples.en: The comparison highlighted a missing trailing newline at the end of the file.
examples.zh: 比较结果标出了文件最后缺少的「末尾换行符」。

examples.en: I kept the trailing newline when comparing what both examples had printed.
examples.zh: 比较两个示例打印的内容时，我保留了「末尾换行符」。

words.enDefinition: The state reached when no more data remains to be read

examples.en: The reader detected an end-of-file condition after the last recorded price.
examples.zh: 读取程序读完最后一个价格后，检测到「文件结束状态」。

examples.en: The example stopped reading once it reached the end-of-file condition in the text file.
examples.zh: 示例读到文本文件的「文件结束状态」后就不再读取。

words.enDefinition: Read one complete line at a time from a text source

examples.en: The program could read line by line and print each entry as it arrived.
examples.zh: 程序可以「逐行读取」，每读到一条就打印出来。

examples.en: Our worksheet showed how to read line by line before adding up the numbers.
examples.zh: 练习表展示了怎样先「逐行读取」，再把数字相加。

collocations: read line by line from a file
decide to read line by line
open a source to read line by line

words.enDefinition: A file containing data that a program reads for processing

examples.en: I chose the smaller input file before running the program again.
examples.zh: 我在再次运行程序前，选择了较小的「输入文件」。

examples.en: The input file held one temperature reading on each line of text.
examples.zh: 「输入文件」的每行文字记录一个温度读数。

words.enDefinition: A file created or updated to hold a program's results

examples.en: The program put the calculated totals in an output file for class.
examples.zh: 程序把算出的合计值放在课上要用的「输出文件」里。

examples.en: I reopened the output file after the run to check its headings.
examples.zh: 运行后，我重新打开「输出文件」来核对标题。

words.enDefinition: End a program's access to an open file and release resources

examples.en: Our tutor explained why we should close a file after writing the result text.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么写完结果文本后要「关闭文件」。

examples.en: I added a note to close a file once the readings had been saved.
examples.zh: 我加了一条备注，提醒保存读数后「关闭文件」。
